QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Admission Hurdle - Courage Test 1
QuestInfo.0: Phase one of the plan is #bGhostacular Mansion#k. Talk to the guide, #bOliver#k, in Funky Station <2>.
QuestInfo.1: Ghostacular Mansion is Fantasy Theme World's top thriller attraction. Oliver says there's a special test of courage you have to pass just to experience this place. Complete the challenge, then talk to #bOliver#k.\r\n\r\nDefeat #r#o8145001##k #bx150#k in #bFunky Station <2>#k.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the test of courage and are now allowed to enter Ghostacular Mansion!

0.msg: #r#fn궁서#Welcome to the spine-chilling Ghostacular Mansion.#k \r\nAre you ready for this experience? We have a #estrict admission policy#n, since you'll need a lot of courage to get through it. This is especially true for children and the elderly.\nIt's that scary!

2.msg: How old do you think we are?! We've got plenty of courage!

3.msg: Ah, my apologies, good people. A simple test is all that's needed to prove your mettle. Simply pass our two tests boasting different levels of difficulty, and all matters will be settled. Such brave individuals as yourselves should be more than up to the task, hmm? What do you say?

yes.0: Ah, wonderful! Then your first task shall be to defeat \n#r#o8145001##k #bx150#k in front of Ghostacular Mansion. An easy task for young heroes, especially those prepared for the horrors inside. Yes?

no.0: And I thought you some big, brave hero. Well, talk to me if you change your mind.

1.0: Yes, I see you've defeated them all.
